note: Private common IPA 727 = the delivered 726 with the RPCS3 Core 934 (per-game settings of the in-game menu saved where the boot reads them, so God of War III stretches again; the Metal 4 present honours Stretch To Display Area), the MeloNX Core 737 (a pad detached while a frame reads the controllers no longer quarantines the engine after a Switch game; a donor kept by the last Switch session is retried and blocks only Switch; plain restart message for other engines) and the two engines the maintainer asked for: XeniOS (Xbox 360: XeniaCore pinned, Apple Metal Shader Converter libmetalirconverter.dylib shipped unmodified except its code signature, the JIT helper extension; the three converter points stay without proof, the maintainer's decision is not a rights holder's authorisation; Core ABI 3 with the in-game display settings: performance overlay, aspect ratio, reported resolution, letterbox) and S2Arm (Switch 2: pinned engine, settings, in-game menu, saves in a Files-visible folder per game with import from the playlist menu). Engine closed sets checked by identity file. MeloNX display tests repaired. Base: the delivered and verified 726. Nothing of this build was run on an iPhone; no FPS, memory, heat or stability claim.
